notes.title: Update #5 - Oculus Rift support
notes.notes:
Here is the 5th EA update and it finally adds the Oculus Rift support to the game. Although this feature is in testing phase right now because we currently use a similar button mapping on all headsets (because of the consistency between the platforms), but this could be unusual for the players who use Rift headset only (most of the Rift games have a different approach to the interaction with the touch controllers). So maybe we change this in the future based on your feedbacks.

If you want to give us more feedback or you have questions and new ideas please join our discord server (https://discord.gg/W9RXnUt) and share them with us.

Or you can follow us on the social sites for more info and updates.
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/techtrou/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/tech_tro

notes.title: Update #1 New weapon + info
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866057/849cc0cec0f1d38d295a2ee808988dbb0f00a11f.png[/img]

Only a week has passed since the launch but we already got tons of feedback and cool new ideas from you and we really appreciate all of them.
If you want to give us feedback too or you have questions and new ideas please join our discord server (https://discord.gg/W9RXnUt) and share them with us.

First of all we made some changes on the unlock score of the weapons based on your feedbacks and we also fix some bugs that made strange effects when certain items was destroyed.

And with this update we also added a new weapon to the game, it is a GLOCK 17 style pistol. I hope you enjoy to unlock and use it. The new weapon is available in all game mode.

If you want to stay up to date follow us on the social sites and we give away game keys on them with every update.
